name: Blackmon Lab open data
description: Machine-readable snapshots of the data that powers coleoguy.github.io. Everything here is CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE for terms and README.md for the human-readable walkthrough.

files.description: Manifest for the line-cross epistasis database.
Over 1,600 line-cross datasets, one row per dataset, with composite genetic effect estimates from SAGA2.
Primary source citations for the line-cross datasets in epistasis-database.csv.
Chromosome-number records collected through CURE courses at Texas A&M. One clade-level citation per species.
